notice: Python and libraries on this page: the examples run in your browser, in Python 3.13.2 with pypdf 6.20.1 and python-docx 1.2.0, the versions the chapter was recorded with, on Pyodide's own lxml 6.0.0, Pillow 11.3.0 and cryptography 45.0.5; the recording ran under Python 3.14.6 with lxml 6.1.3, Pillow 12.3.0 and cryptography 50.0.2. Each example was checked in the browser against its recorded result. Two examples need something a browser cannot give (a second Python, and the pdfminer.six package) and are shown as recorded, not run. Not executed at all: Microsoft Word and any PDF viewer (LibreOffice and the poppler and qpdf tools stood in for them), the language-model clean-up of extracted text, and the Mu editor. The chapter's PDF and Word files are built by the examples themselves; none of the book's own files is on this page.
